title: Financial Controller
description:
Part-Time Financial Controller Cardiff 2 Days Per Week

Flexible Working Forward-Thinking SME

Are you an experienced Financial Controller looking for a part-time opportunity where you can genuinely influence the direction of a growing business?

We're working with a forward-thinking SME in Cardiff that is looking to appoint a commercially minded Financial Controller to join the business on a part-time basis, working 2 days per week.

This is a hands-on yet highly strategic role, ideal for someone who enjoys being more than just the person behind the numbers. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders, providing meaningful financial insight, strengthening reporting and helping shape the future direction of the business.

The Role

As Financial Controller, you will take ownership of the financial reporting function while acting as a trusted business partner to the wider organisation.

You'll be responsible for:
- Leading and managing the day-to-day finance function.
- Producing accurate and insightful management reporting and financial information.
- Working closely with senior stakeholders to provide commercial insight and support decision-making.
- Business partnering across the organisation, challenging performance and identifying opportunities.
- Supporting the strategic financial planning and development of the business.
- Managing budgets, forecasts and financial performance.
- Improving financial processes, controls and reporting.
- Managing, developing and coaching a Finance Assistant, helping them grow and develop within the business.
- Supporting relationships with B2 B clients across Europe and overseas markets.
- Working with Xero to maintain and develop efficient finance processes.

About You

We're looking for someone who is commercially focused, confident working with senior stakeholders and enjoys operating within an entrepreneurial SME environment.

Ideally, you will be:
- Qualified or QBE, with strong practical Financial Controller experience.
- Experienced within an SME or growing business where you have had genuine ownership of the finance function.
- Strong in management reporting, analysis and business partnering.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to turn financial information into actionable business insight.
- Experienced working with B2 B customers, ideally across Europe and international markets.
- Comfortable using Xero.
- A confident communicator who can work effectively with both senior stakeholders and non-finance teams.
- An experienced people manager who enjoys developing and coaching junior finance talent.
- Based within a commutable distance of Cardiff, as the role requires you to be office-based 2 days per week.

Why This Role?

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Financial Controller who wants impact without the commitment of a traditional five-day week.

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with the leadership team, influence commercial decisions, develop the finance function and play a key role in supporting the continued growth of an ambitious SME.

If you're looking for a part-time Financial Controller role where your experience will genuinely make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance Officer

Finance Officer

title: Front of House / Facilities Assistant
description:
Company Profile

CBRE is the global leader in real estate services and leverages the industry's most powerful knowledge base to meet the commercial real estate needs of its clients worldwide. Our vision is to be the preeminent, vertically integrated, globally capable real estate service firm.

Job Title:

Front of House / Facilities Assistant (Cardiff)

The Facilities Assistant is responsible for delivering an exceptional Workplace Experience and Front of House service, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment for employees, visitors, and contractors.

Role Summary:
- Act as the first point of contact for workplace and facilities-related enquiries, delivering an excellent employee and visitor experience.
- Provide a professional meet-and-greet service for visitors and notify hosts of their arrival.
- Process all new starters and leavers through the access control system, keeping records up to date.
- Monitor the Facilities Team inbox, resolving queries or escalating issues appropriately.
- Manage meeting room bookings, catering requests and room set-ups as required.
- Manage incoming and outgoing mail, including distribution, processing, and franking services.
- Support with raising POs, invoicing, making payments and reconciling company credit card transactions.
- Manage archive storage requests.
- Manage printed stationery requests.
- Assist with group hotel, travel and external meeting venue bookings.
- Organise couriers as required.
- Coordinate and manage car parking arrangements.
- Manage employee locker allocation and records.
- Maintain security for the site by managing all access in and out for colleagues and visitors, including issuing visitor passes as required.
- Manage the visitor tracking system and notify Building Management with a daily visitor list.
- Support the Facilities Specialist in maintaining statutory compliance across the site.
- Support the Facilities Specialist to coordinate contractor activities and ensure adherence to site safety requirements.
- Assist with planned preventative maintenance and reactive maintenance records.
- Support Health & Safety inspections, audits, and risk management activities.
- Support Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery planning activities.
- Act as Fire Warden and support emergency evacuation procedures.
- Coordinate DSE assessment requirements and workplace adjustments where appropriate.
- Support other sites when required.
- Contribute to the business Energy & Sustainability plans by sharing ideas and implementing improvements.

Experience Required
- Communication Skills
- Ability to comprehend and interpret instructions, short correspondence and memos, and ask clarifying questions to ensure understanding.
- Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
- Ability to respond to common enquiries or complaints from clients, co-workers and supervisors.
- Ability to effectively present information to an internal department and/or large groups of employees.
- Organisation & Planning
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload, manage competing demands and meet deadlines.
- IT Skills
- Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Outlook.
- Comfortable with and embracing of new technologies and digital tools, including apps, databases, work order management systems, social networking platforms, cloud technologies, handheld mobile technologies and communications tools.
- Results Oriented
- Ability to achieve business goals, with a concern for working well, surpassing standards of excellence and a passion for challenges.
- Customer Focused
- Develop strong customer relationships by listening to and satisfying customer needs.

DISCLAIMER

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with the role. CBRE reserves the right to amend the duties and responsibilities of the role in line with business requirements.

title: Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator
description:
Job Title: Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator

Location: Cardiff, South Wales

Salary/Benefits: 26k - 32k + Training & Benefits

A UKAS accredited asbestos consultancy is recruiting for a detail-oriented Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator. They are ideally seeking someone within a commutable distance to their office in South Wales, but hybrid / home working is a possibility for the right candidate. It is essential that applicants hold the BOHS P402 or RSPH equivalent. This role would suit someone who would like to transition from site work and utilise their hands-on experience to quality check survey reports. We can consider candidates from the following locations: Cardiff, Barry, Penarth, Caerphilly, Bridgend, Porthcawl, Blackwood, Pontypridd, Tonypandy, Merthyr Tydfil, Pontypool, Risca, Abergavenny, Chepstow, Cwmbran, Magor, Lydney, Barry, Rhoose, Neath, Swansea, Cinderford, Ross-on-Wye, Filton, Yate, Thornbury, Portishead, Severn Beach.

title: Training Course Coordinator
description:
Training Course Coordinator

Location: Hybrid, 1 day per week from home Based from the Cardiff office CF15 7 QZ
Salary: £26,395 per annum

Why do we want you

Astutis (part of Wilmington plc) is looking for a highly organised, people-focused individual who loves delivering great service and keeping everything running smoothly.

Working within our Operations Team, you ll look after a caseload of clients and learners, supporting them from the moment a course is booked right through to exams and certification.

You ll coordinate our virtual, classroom and in-company Health, Safety and Environmental courses, handling everything from learner registrations and course materials to customer communications, reporting and exam support.

You ll need a great eye for detail, strong communication skills and a proactive approach to solving problems, while working closely with our Sales and Operations teams to give every client and learner a brilliant experience.

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc s career site.

At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked apply !

You ll be Responsible For:
- Be the go-to person for your clients and learners, supporting them from course booking right through to exams and certification.
- Keep courses running smoothly by managing confirmations, learner registrations, course materials, attendance records and feedback.
- Make sure learner information is accurate and up to date, including registrations with awarding bodies such as NEBOSH, IOSH and IEMA.
- Build great relationships with clients and work closely with our Sales Account Managers to provide progress updates, reports and a seamless customer experience.
- Keep an eye on learner progress and step in with extra support when needed, including study tools, extensions and resits.
- Stay on top of deadlines, SLAs and KPIs, using our systems and technology to keep everything organised and accurate.
- Work closely with the wider Operations team to share ideas, improve the way we do things and lend a hand when things get busy.

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Knowledge of relevant computer systems including administrative systems, CRM, MS Teams and MS Office packages.
- Solid understanding and knowledge of customer service principles and standards.
- Knowledge of principles and practices of Sales, and how this relates to after-sales customer support and care.
- Excellent understanding and working knowledge of all Microsoft packages
- Excellent word-processing skills
- Attention to detail, including accuracy of information recording, data entry, and communication clarity across all processes, systems and planning tools.

It would be great if you had:
- Previous experience working in a training company.
- General understanding of relevant training certifications and governing bodies including NEBOSH and IOSH advantageous.

What's the Best Thing About This Role

You ll make a real difference to learners, supporting them throughout their training journey while building great relationships along the way. It s varied, people-focused and you ll see the impact of your work every day.

What s the Most Challenging Thing About This Role

There can be a lot of plates spinning at once, with multiple courses, deadlines and customer requests to manage. You ll need to stay organised, keep an eye on the details and be comfortable juggling priorities when things get busy.

We know it s not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role s location by the start of their employment.

Before you go

About us

Astutis is a market leader in workplace health, safety, and environmental training, helping organisations create safer, healthier work environments. As part of Wilmington plc, we are committed to delivering high-quality courses and outstanding customer service.

Join us and do Work That Means Something

At Wilmington plc, we help global customers to do the right business in the right way - providing trusted data, insights, and education to navigate the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) landscape.

When you join us, you ll not only make a real difference for our customers, you ll also enjoy flexibility through hybrid working and benefit from a wide range of learning, career, and development opportunities.

Whether you're just starting out, returning to work after a break, or looking to take your next step, you ll be doing work with meaning.

Join us and make a real difference. Click on APPLY today!

title: Team Coordinator
description:
Dedicated to sustainable development, Arup is a collective of designers, consultants and experts working globally.

We're looking for an experienced Team Coordinator to join Arup and provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support across the Property Science Industry portfolio.

You'll play a key role in keeping the team organised and running effectively, supporting operational and project activity, producing high-quality documents and presentations, coordinating stakeholders and events, and assisting with bids and wider business development activity.
